now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 18, Garrett turns Mike into the cyborg Deathlok, using his son as leverage.

proposed.text: In episode 21, Garrett turns Mike into the cyborg Deathlok, using his son as leverage.

changes.evidence: Deathlok does not appear in episode 18 (Providence); his appearances run AoS 1x13, 1x16, 1x20, 1x21, 1x22. The record's last event, Garrett holding Ace over him, is shown in episode 21 (Ragtag): Garrett praises his Bogota kill and rewards him with footage of his son, who is held in a cell. Episode 21 also follows Garrett's reveal (ep 17), so no spoiler.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 8, Jakob and Petra use a piece of the Asgardian Berserker staff to hunt down its other pieces, until Ward and May beat them.

changes.evidence: In episode 8 (The Well), Ward and May defeat Nystrom, Larsen and the Paganists at the Irish church and S.H.I.E.L.D. takes the staff; both characters' infoboxes list their status as In Custody, not at large.
